difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the module of principal parts of order k with the quotient of the base change S tensor M by the (k+1)-st power of the diagonal ideal, in a way compatible with the universal differential operator (statement lines 35146-35157). The proof does not compute the quotient abstractly: it verifies the order-k conditions for the class of one tensor m, invokes the universal property to produce the map, and writes down the inverse explicitly, leaving the final composite check to the reader (proof lines 35159-35187). Verifying the operator conditions on that particular element is the step that makes the universal property applicable. H2.
